_about: The Poetic Edda in Henry Adams Bellows's translation (American-Scandinavian Foundation, 1923), as the relay asked: published 1923, US public domain since 2019. Clean Gutenberg text, translator in the title.

edda-bellows: The Poetic Edda, tr. Henry Adams Bellows (1923)

_excluded.edda-other-translations: Thorpe and Blackwell's Elder and Younger Eddas (PG 14726, 1866) and Morris and Magnusson's Volsunga Saga with Edda excerpts (PG 1152): other translations, not named by the relay; candidates for a later batch
_excluded.edda-retellings: Faraday's The Edda (PG 13007-13008), Guerber's Myths of the Norsemen (28497), Wilmot-Buxton (29551): studies and retellings
